ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Ship Shields — Modulated Plasma Fields
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHIELD_MODS_LEVERAGE_1 — the bespoke building-scale shield comp, ruled owner/2026-09-04 by card (design/Jawa/canon_reintegration_plan.md sec G.9: "bespoke building-scale comp, NOW... the new C# system's maintenance cost accepted"), superseding the earlier survey's lean toward forking a Vanilla Expanded engine (VEF's CompShieldField turned out to be a pawn-apparel comp, not building-scale; see the item file's source-verification section).
One `RUT_ShieldGenerator` building, one field active at a time, switched by installing a module (shd:loadout-tradeoff) rather than four separate buildings:
- Bubble/kinetic (shd:bubble-not-wall, default, no module needed): a real subclass of vanilla's own `CompProjectileInterceptor` (the same base class Odyssey's native gravship shield generator uses, RimWorld/CompGravshipShieldGenerator.cs) rather than a fork of any mod's engine. Forcibly draining it to 0 hit points triggers a collapse explosion (shd:bubble-not-wall's "prone to overheating or even explosion when forcibly collapsed"). - Thermal veil (shd:thermal-veil, module-gated): partially rejects outdoor temperature drift via `GenTemperature.ControlTemperatureTempChange` + `PushHeat` (the same primitives vanilla heaters/coolers use), power-only, never a full cancellation — the room still climbs toward extremes, just far more slowly. - Particulate screen (shd:particulate-screen, module-gated): clears weather-deposited filth in radius each interval, repels small wild animals out of radius (a real vanilla flee job), and negates the one concrete vanilla mechanism matching "vapor, bio contamination... damage completely" — airborne Toxic Fallout exposure for pawns and crops in radius. Vanilla has no other direct-HP-damage weather effect to negate (sandstorms/rain only touch accuracy, move speed and mood).
Canon-wide "slow-moving things pass through every shield" (shd:shield- collapse-evacuate) is implemented as a Harmony prefix on `CompProjectileInterceptor.CheckIntercept`, scoped to this mod's own `CompShieldGenerator` only — vanilla's native gravship/mech shields are left untouched pending a separate, larger call on whether to extend it further.
Predictive shield-failure alerts (shd:shield-collapse-evacuate's evacuation warning): the bubble generator now watches its own hit-point decline and sends one warning letter when collapse is projected within about an in-game hour, clearing once it recovers.
Landing-hazard advisory (shd:no-hard-landing-gate): a Harmony postfix on the confirmed-live `Scenario.PostGravshipLanded` hook sends a single non-blocking letter if the landing map has an extreme-heat or airborne-particulate hazard with no matching shield configured and powered. The design doc's other half (escalating damage ticks for staying unshielded) is a separate, larger mechanism and remains open work — see the item file.
Full spec: design/Jawa/proposals/ship_shields_deep_design.md. Survey and scoping history: infrastructure/state/items/SHIELD_MODS_LEVERAGE_1.md, research/Jawa/shield_mods_survey_2026-09-02.md.
